test_cases.title: Verify WashTAB Home Page Loads Successfully
test_cases.objective: Ensure the WashTAB home dashboard loads with key UI elements visible.
preconditions: User has access to the WashTAB application URL
User session is active and user is logged in
steps: Observe the page header and dashboard area
Verify the presence of the home icon, notifications icon, and user chip displaying 'haklarr'
Verify that multiple dashboard tiles (innerBtn elements) are displayed
expected_results: WashTAB home page loads successfully without errors
Header icons such as home, notifications, and arrow back are visible
Dashboard tiles are displayed and appear clickable

test_cases.title: Verify Logout from User Chip
test_cases.objective: Confirm that the user can log out using the logout icon in the user chip.
preconditions: User is logged into the WashTAB application
steps: Locate the user chip displaying 'haklarr' in the header
Click the log-out icon inside the user chip
expected_results: User is redirected away from the authenticated home page

test_cases.title: Verify Notifications Button Disabled State
test_cases.objective: Ensure the notifications button is disabled and not clickable when aria-disabled is true.
steps: Locate the notifications button with id 'notifications-button'
Observe that the button has aria-disabled set to true
Attempt to click the notifications button
expected_results: Clicking the button does not trigger any action or navigation

test_cases.title: Verify Home Icon Presence and Interaction
test_cases.objective: Validate that the home icon is visible and functions as a navigation control.
steps: Locate the icon with name 'home' in the header
expected_results: Home icon is visible in the header
Clicking the home icon keeps the user on or navigates to the home dashboard

test_cases.title: Verify Arrow Back Icon Behavior
test_cases.objective: Confirm that the arrow back icon functions as a back navigation control.
preconditions: User previously navigated from another page to the WashTAB home page
expected_results: Arrow back icon is visible in the header
Clicking the icon navigates to the previous page in the session history

test_cases.title: Verify Dashboard Tile Interaction
test_cases.objective: Ensure dashboard tiles represented by innerBtn elements respond to user interaction.
steps: Locate one of the dashboard tiles with class 'innerBtn'
expected_results: Associated action or navigation is triggered for the selected tile

test_cases.title: Verify Coming Soon Tile is Non-Functional
test_cases.objective: Ensure the 'Coming Soon!' tile indicates unavailable functionality and does not trigger navigation.
steps: Locate the tile displaying text 'Coming Soon!'
Attempt to click the 'Coming Soon!' tile
expected_results: Clicking the tile does not navigate to a new page or trigger an active workflow
